Description: Department managers may approve routine operational software or supply requisitions up to $5,000 without competitive bidding, provided an active PO is issued before delivery.
Any vendor engagement valued between $25,001 and $100,000 requires at least three written competitive RFx quotes evaluated by a Category Manager prior to award.
Capital commitments, core banking infrastructure, or multi-year vendor contracts exceeding $250,000 require formal Procurement Committee and CFO signature.
Third-party vendors storing, processing, or transmitting customer PII or payment data must pass a SOC 2 Type II and PCI-DSS audit before onboarding.
All US-based suppliers must submit a valid IRS Form W-9, ACH bank verification letter, and Certificate of Insurance prior to supplier master activation.
SaaS vendor agreements containing evergreen auto-renewal clauses must be flagged in the CLM repository at least 60 days prior to the non-renewal notice deadline.
Supplier invoices for physical IT or office shipments require a 3-way match comparing the Purchase Order, warehouse receiving dock log, and vendor invoice before payment release.
Bypassing competitive RFP rules for purchases over $25,000 requires a written Sole-Source Justification memo proving unique IP or regulatory exclusivity.
Standard corporate supplier payment terms are Net 45 from receipt of an undisputed invoice; early-payment Net 15 terms require at least a 2% prompt-pay discount.
External management or legal consulting Statements of Work must cap billable out-of-pocket expenses at 10% of labor fees and define fixed deliverable milestones.
RFPs exceeding $100,000 must invite at least one certified minority-, women-, veteran-, or LGBTQ-owned business enterprise to submit a proposal.
Invoices submitted by vendors without a valid pre-approved Purchase Order number referenced on the billing header will be automatically rejected by Accounts Payable.
Any vendor operating as a sub-processor under CCPA or GLBA rules must execute the standard corporate Data Processing Addendum alongside the Master Services Agreement.
Tier-1 strategic suppliers with annual spend exceeding $500,000 must participate in quarterly SLA scorecard reviews led by Vendor Management.
Designated departmental Procurement Card holders may charge low-risk, one-off vendor purchases up to $2,500 per transaction, reconciled monthly with itemized receipts.
